summary: Phase B (compliance & security) validated. 37/37 backend pytest cases passed covering moderation (unit + 3 endpoints), age gate (401/403/200/400/idempotency + session invalidation), Stripe webhook (503 with missing secret, route exists), admin moderation queue (auth + filters + hide/restore/delete + invalid action), and regression on posts/tiers/me/vote. Frontend smoke: bundle compiles, landing page renders cleanly, /age-gate route correctly protected by navigator (redirects unauthenticated users back to /).

react_native_issues.issue: Browser console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Likely from theme.ts brutalShadow usage. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (used across many screens incl. age-gate.tsx)
Browser console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Should migrate from prop to style.

action_items: Pre-existing (non-blocking): migrate deprecated 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' across the theme.
Optional: full UI test of age-gate flow requires real Google OAuth — not feasible automated. Manual smoke recommended after first Google sign-in.
critical_code_review_comments: moderation.py line 52 has a Python implicit string concat bug: '"preto" "negao"' produces a single stem 'pretonegao' that will never match real input. It's harmless because 'preto' is whitelisted and 'negao' alone is not blocked, but the intent looks like two stems. Recommend fixing to two separate entries or removing.

POST /api/stripe/webhook is mounted on raw `app` (correct, to receive raw body) but `app.include_router(api_router)` runs after the explicit route — FastAPI matches the explicit route first, so no conflict. Verified by 503 response in current state.

auth/confirm-age idempotency works but does not reset 'age_blocked_at' if a user later confirms with a valid year on a different account/session; in practice the underage path delete_many's sessions so re-confirmation is not possible without a new login — acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Tests seed transient TEST_ users + sessions directly in Mongo and tear them down after each test class. Admin token bound to existing rodrigocontecunha@gmail.com user_id where present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase B (iteration 7) fully verified. Stripe webhook live-signed test deferred — STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is empty by design (returns 503). When secret is configured, signature mismatch test will return 400 (already covered logically). Moderation has a minor implicit string-concat quirk on line 52 of moderation.py that does not affect correctness (see code review comments).
